verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only unquantified marketing claims of "ultra-low latency" and "low latency interactions." It has no documented end-to-end latency figures and no latency tuning guidance to back those claims. The conversation-flow settings for turn-taking, interruptions and timeouts are a related but different feature, and nothing documents them as latency tuning.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
